summary:
Iteration 17 — Validated the 4 user-reported fixes on /crm and Send modals plus CRM regression. ALL PASS. (1) CRM bloc-notes no longer flickers/clobbers: typed '10x100
50+25
main doeuvre
200/4' (~4s) crossing the 800ms autosave boundary, textarea retained ALL characters, focus retained on client-notes-textarea, client-detail panel stayed mounted (no remount). Preview showed '= 1 000 / = 75 / = 50' and notes-total = '1 125 €'. (2) Sort dropdown options 'Nom (A → Z)' / 'Récemment modifié' / 'Récemment ajouté' all reorder the list. After editing Amy COUFFON's notes, 'Récemment modifié' brought her to the top. (3) Desktop nav has Catalogue link → /catalog. Mobile bottom-nav entries are exactly [Accueil, Devis, IA, Factures, CRM] — Catalogue absent as expected. (4) SendQuoteModal and SendInvoiceModal both expose sticky-bottom-0 footer with confirm-send-btn ('Envoyer par email') and send-whatsapp-btn ('Envoyer par WhatsApp') both visible in the 1920x1080 viewport without scroll. Regression: client list loads (32 clients), search works, client detail/timeline render, edit/delete buttons present, mobile back-to-list-btn hides detail correctly. Notes were restored to original (empty) for Amy COUFFON. No real emails were triggered.

action_items: All 4 reported fixes are confirmed working. Carry-over from iter16: React DOM nesting warnings in QuoteForm/InvoiceForm live preview (out of scope, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: CRM.jsx ClientDetail useEffect deps [client.id] for timeline fetch and patchCacheItem in onUpdated correctly break the flicker loop. Good fix.

Notes auto-save effect deps still include 'client' (full object) and 'onUpdated' on line 115. Because onUpdated is recreated each parent render, the effect re-evaluates often; the early-return `if (notes === (client.notes || '')) return;` prevents redundant PATCH but the cleanup clears the pending timer on every render. This is fine because `notes` only changes via user input and the typed value remains in local state, but consider wrapping onUpdated in useCallback in CRM parent for stability.
evalExpression uses Function() constructor — safe because input is regex-restricted to /^[\d+\-*/().,]+$/. OK.

SendQuoteModal & SendInvoiceModal: sticky footer correctly placed inside the scrollable container (max-h-[75vh]/[70vh] overflow-y-auto) so bottom-0 anchors to viewport of the scroll container. Verified buttons render in viewport at 1920x1080. Good.
BottomNav uses data-testid=`nav-${label.toLowerCase()}` — Catalogue intentionally absent. Consistent.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily wrote notes to Amy COUFFON (first client by name) then restored to original empty value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 confirmed all 4 fixes (notes flicker, sorting, desktop-only Catalogue, sticky Email+WhatsApp send modal footers) and full CRM regression. Auth bypass: page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('sr_auth','true');"). Send buttons on /quotes list have data-testid=send-quote-{uuid}; on /invoices list have send-invoice-{uuid}. No backend testing performed this iteration (per request).
rca_of_issue: Previous flicker RCA confirmed fixed: invalidate('clients') in onUpdated was nulling the cached clients list mid-typing, causing CRM to render the loading spinner and unmount ClientDetail; the user's in-progress typing was lost when the textarea remounted with stale client.notes. Fix: onUpdated now calls patchCacheItem('clients', id, updatedClient) which updates that single item in place. ClientDetail's notes-fetch useEffect dep [client.id] (not [client]) also prevents re-running when only client.notes/updated_at change.
